summary.text: Garland Pierce is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 48 since 2005 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as Baptist minister.

paragraphs.text: Garland Pierce served in the U.S. Army from 1971 to 1974, according to the General Assembly and Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Fayetteville State University and graduate study at Shaw Divinity School.
Pierce assumed office in the North Carolina House in 2005 and has served 11 terms there, according to the General Assembly.
The General Assembly lists Hoke and Scotland counties for District 48 and a mailing address in Wagram.
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
